entries.zh: 绵纸（绵软纤维所制的白色细纸，西语谓佳美之白纸）
entries.en: fine white paper; soft cotton-fibre paper (Sp. papel blanco curioso)

entries.zh: 金板（贴金箔之板片；第二字存疑〔板/枚〕，暂取板义）
entries.en: gilded board / sheet of gold plate (second character uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字第二字有原件存疑标记〔板/枚〕，据西语 papel dorado 取板义。

entries.zh: 金箔（贴于纸上之金片，即金泊）
entries.en: gold foil; gold leaf laid on paper (panes de oro)

entries.zh: 银板（贴银之板片；第二字存疑〔板/枚〕，暂取板义）
entries.en: silvered board / sheet of silver plate (second character uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字第二字有原件存疑标记〔板/枚〕，据西语 papel plateado 取板义。

entries.zh: 银纸（贴银或涂银之纸；或指祭祀焚化之银色纸钱；末一字污损难辨，释义存疑）
entries.en: silvered paper; silver paper, possibly spirit money for offerings (third syllable damaged; gloss provisional)
entries.notes: 闽南音写末一字有污损难辨标记；冥用纸钱之义系从马尼拉祭俗推得，存疑。

entries.zh: 空纸；空白未写之纸
entries.en: blank paper; unwritten sheet

entries.zh: 金山（金子之山；承纸类词头当指纸扎金山，焚化之冥供，与银山对举）
entries.en: Gold Mountain; paper effigy of a golden mountain burned as an offering
entries.notes: 西语释义文句残损难通（有难解之词），金山义据汉字与音写立释；纸扎冥供之义由词头 papel 及下条银山对举推得。

entries.zh: 银山（纸扎银山，冥供；与金山对举；西语释义尾部残缺，释义存疑）
entries.en: Silver Mountain; paper effigy of a silver mountain (Spanish gloss truncated; gloss provisional)
entries.notes: 西语栏以残缺符截断，据金山条对举补足立义，故低置信。

entries.zh: 金榜（科举放榜张挂示众之名榜；后一音写污损难辨，释义存疑）
entries.en: golden placard; the posted honor roll of the imperial examination (second reading smudged; gloss provisional)
entries.notes: 第二音写有污损难辨标记；榜义据汉字与西语 examen 立释。

entries.zh: 招货（悬于门首招财进货之吉纸、招纸）
entries.en: paper hung at the door to attract trade and goods

entries.zh: 手本（下属谒见上司时所投递的名帖、禀帖）
entries.en: calling card / formal presentation paper submitted by an inferior on a visit

entries.zh: 粗纸（质地粗糙之廉价纸）
entries.en: coarse, cheap paper

entries.zh: 状纸／状式（裁就书写诉状、呈文之纸；首字存疑〔状/床〕，次字污损难辨，释义存疑）
entries.en: paper cut for petitions and legal plaints (first character uncertain; gloss provisional)
entries.notes: 汉字首字有存疑标记〔状/床〕且次字污损难辨，取状纸义依西语 peticiones。

entries.zh: 空白余纸（白纸；或指写剩之余纸；首字存疑〔问/间〕）
entries.en: blank paper; leftover sheet (first character uncertain)
entries.notes: 首字有原件存疑标记〔问/间〕，据西语空白纸义暂释。

entries.zh: 柱联（题写联语、贴挂于柱与墙壁之纸，即楹联）
entries.en: pillar couplet; paper couplets pasted on pillars or hung on walls

entries.zh: 敕符令（敕令符纸，辟邪镇祟之符，西语谓贴此则魔鬼不来）
entries.en: talismanic decree paper; charm said to keep the Devil away

entries.zh: 符令（符箓令牌，书符之纸）
entries.en: talisman; charm paper

entries.zh: 香帖（芬芳香气之纸帖；西语谓饰有花卉之纸）
entries.en: scented paper card; perfumed card

entries.zh: 度牒（官府给发僧道的出家执照文牒）
entries.en: ordination certificate (licence issued to a monk, bonzo)

entries.zh: 指头弹（屈指弹出声响，即弹指）
entries.en: snap of the fingers; flick made with the finger-tips

entries.zh: 弹（弹指作响；屈指弹出）
entries.en: snap of the fingers; to flick with the finger

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: manuscript damaged; gloss not recoverable
